clips.title: The story
paras: In Southshore, Chef Jessen works to feed the town amid constant border tensions. He is best known for his famous turtle bisque.

Chef Jessen supplies meat and provisions in Southshore, in the southern Hillsbrad Foothills, for locals and visiting Alliance soldiers. He is a skilled cook. Before plague and war disrupted northern Lordaeron, he often traveled north past Dalaran to the shores of Lordamere Lake. There he gathered meat from native snapjaw turtles to make his prized, hearty Soothing Turtle Bisque. He will share the recipe with travelers who help him gather its ingredients.
